module.purpose: Provides a Svelte 5 reactive hook that integrates TanStack DB's live query capabilities with Svelte's reactivity system, enabling automatic subscription and granular updates to query results.
module.summary: This file exports a `useLiveQuery` function with multiple overloads that creates reactive live queries using TanStack DB. It handles query functions, configuration objects, and pre-created collections, managing their lifecycle through Svelte's reactivity primitives ($derived, $effect, $state). The hook returns a reactive object with query data, state map, status flags, and the underlying collection for mutations.
module.businessContext: Enables real-time database queries in Svelte 5 applications with automatic reactivity. Critical for applications requiring live data updates without manual subscription management. Failure breaks real-time data synchronization in Svelte 5 apps.

detail.signature: export function useLiveQuery(configOrQueryOrCollection: any, deps: Array<() => unknown> = []): UseLiveQueryReturn<any> | UseLiveQueryReturnWithCollection<any, any, any>
preconditions: configOrQueryOrCollection must be a query function, configuration object, or a live query collection
deps, if provided, must be an array of functions that return reactive values
postconditions: Returns a UseLiveQueryReturn or UseLiveQueryReturnWithCollection object that is reactive in Svelte 5
The returned object contains data, isLoading, isError, status, and collection properties as applicable
invariants: The query re-executes when dependencies change
Data updates are granular through change events
Reactivity is maintained with proper Svelte 5 usage patterns
edgeCases: When queryFn returns null or undefined, the query is disabled and returns null
When a collection with syncMode 'on-demand' is passed directly, a warning is logged and no data is loaded
When toValue fails on configOrQueryOrCollection, the original parameter is used
When collection status is 'idle', startSyncImmediate is called

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Uses fallback with toValue or returns null for disabled queries

stateMutations: Updates internal reactive data and status

specLiterals.value:
[useLiveQuery] Warning: Passing a collection with syncMode "on-demand" directly to useLiveQuery will not load any data. In on-demand mode, data is only loaded when queries with predicates request it.

Instead, use a query builder function:
  const { data } = useLiveQuery((q) => q.from({ c: myCollection }).select(({ c }) => c))

Or switch to syncMode "eager" if you want all data to sync automatically.
specLiterals.role: warning message for invalid usage with on-demand syncMode
